title: Violence and power: Las Casas, the New Laws and Valladolid
goal: Read how some Spaniards criticised the abuses of the conquest, and use the present subjunctive to say what people ask others to do.

items: Use *pedir que* and *querer que* with the subjunctive to say what people ask others to do.
Say what the friar Montesinos did in 1511.
Say what the New Laws of 1542 forbade.
Say what Sepúlveda and Las Casas defend in the debate at Valladolid.
Say what Las Casas asks the king to do and what the king orders in Valladolid.
